headline: Bata India informs exchanges about a change in its senior management personnel.
summary: Bata India Limited has submitted an official regulatory disclosure regarding a change in its senior management personnel (SMP). The filing was made pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements. Specific names or reasons for the departure were not detailed in this initial filing snippet. Retail investors should note SMP changes as they can signal internal restructuring or strategic shifts within the footwear major.
why_it_matters: Management changes can impact retail execution and near-term strategy.
